title: premarket full record
description: One symbol's full pre-market summary up to a cutoff (sourcing-py etrade premarket full, premarket_live/premarket-D.jsonl): Massive minute bars started in [04:00 ET, cutoff) on `date`, with the same definitions as massive-ext (vw-weighted VWAP, last traded bar's close, high/low, volume).

cutoff.description: HH:MM ET; bars that START before it.

pm_last.description: Close of the last bar that traded before the cutoff.

pm_last_t.description: Start time of that bar, epoch ms.

data_until.description: UTC time Massive's data reaches (run time - feed delay).

complete.description: data_until >= cutoff: the whole window was available.
